note: Field catalogue for every register in context-map-1. Templates under templates/ follow it column for column. Draft for owner review; descriptions are this project's own wording.

pseudo_record_types.pid: P&ID sheets read into the PLANT layer (drawing register + sheet reads)

fields.name: tag
fields.description: The tag exactly as the plant writes it (P-101, TT-2207). Never renumbered.

fields.name: plant
fields.description: Plant id, or a site scope id such as UTIL for site utilities, as declared in the map's scopes.

fields.name: unit
fields.description: Unit (or area) id inside the plant. Required when the plant declares units.

fields.name: system
fields.description: System inside the unit (heating medium, CIP supply). Optional level.

fields.name: kind
fields.description: The map's own small item kind. Leave empty to let the tag letters suggest one for review.

fields.name: description
fields.description: Service description.

fields.name: dexpi_class
fields.description: DEXPI 2.0.1 class name, for example CentrifugalPump, Transmitter.

fields.name: cfihos_tag_class
fields.description: CFIHOS tag class code (CFIHOS-...) from the RDL version the site uses.

fields.name: parent_tag
fields.description: Tag this item is part of (a motor's pump, an instrument's valve).

fields.name: former_tag
fields.description: Earlier tag(s) for the same position, separated by ';'. Kept as aliases.

fields.name: safety_relevant
fields.description: yes when the item is in a protective function (relief, interlock, CCP). Never reviewed as green.

fields.name: locator
fields.description: Where in the source this row's values are, when it is not simply this file and row (page, sheet and cell, clause, screen).

fields.name: note
fields.description: Free text for the person who fills the row in. Never parsed into a value.

registers.name: tag lookup table

fields.description: Documents it was based on as id@revision, ';' separated.

fields.name: manufacturer
fields.description: Manufacturer, for vendor documents.

fields.name: locator
fields.description: Where in the source this row's values are, when it is not simply this file and row (page, sheet and cell, clause, screen).

fields.name: status
fields.description: Review status of the row. Empty means unverified.

fields.name: note
fields.description: Free text for the person who fills the row in. Never parsed into a value.

registers.name: local rulings
registers.notes: Extends one_map.py's decisions.csv (conflict_id,status,by,on,note). Routing, approval and history of a ruling belong to an external governed service.

fields.name: ruling_id
fields.description: Ruling id.

fields.name: concerns
fields.description: Conflict id (SITE/CONFLICT/C-...) or qualified item id.

fields.name: attribute
fields.description: Attribute the ruling is about.

fields.name: ruling
fields.description: What was decided.

fields.name: chosen_source
fields.description: Source id accepted, if any.

fields.name: chosen_value
fields.description: Value accepted, if any.

fields.name: reason
fields.description: Why, in the person's words.

fields.name: by
fields.description: Who ruled (name or role).

fields.name: on
fields.description: Date.
